propositions: git-remote-s3 must be declared as an optional s3 extra in pyproject.toml with minimum version constraint >=0.3.2
require_s3_helper() must validate both console script presence (via shutil.which) and distribution version (via importlib.metadata) using stdlib-only parsing
require_s3_helper() must raise OptionalDependencyError with actionable pip install message when helper is missing, version is too old, or version is unparseable
guard_import must support the s3 extra to enable consistent missing-dependency messaging across all optional extras
version parsing must extract leading numeric components from the first three version segments and compare as tuple; suffixes like .post1 are ignored
_optional.py must remain stdlib-only (no packaging or git_remote_s3 imports) while unit tests cover all version comparison edge cases
